title: Single hieratic sign, D. Assiut N13.1 TN9 (AKU HT 14503)

object.name: D. Assiut N13.1 TN9
object.content: Kolophon (Scribe Khaemwaset, praise to scribe, praise to Thoth, sky of myrrh)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 14503

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 14503; AKU grapheme M0260 (AKU GR 372). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: M23 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 289. Occurrence: line 3; find place Gebel Assiut al-gharbi; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 15.1 x 6.4 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie, Amenhotep III.". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
